name: dividend
description: Make sense of your Claude Code session's context, prompt cache, and usage limits through quick tips and short lessons. Insights come from what Claude Code reports; everything stays within your machine.

tips.title: Cost tips
tips.description: Suggest ways to trim what a session carries and costs, from what Claude Code itself reports.

cache.title: Prompt cache tips
cache.description: When the cache went cold and why, a word before your next message once it has lapsed, and an offer to compact before a break.

context.title: Context tips
context.description: What a long conversation, MCP tool descriptions and instruction files add to every message.

limits.title: Limit tips
limits.description: Your 5-hour and weekly limits, the spend alert, and when a lighter model would do.

actions.title: Action buttons
actions.description: Offer Compact now and Ask Claude buttons on the tips where they help. They act only when you press them.

budgetUsd.title: Spend alert (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Say so each time a session passes another multiple of this many dollars at list price, as /cost counts it. 0 turns it off. On a seat plan this is not your bill.
